result.instructions: Tools for Qwilr, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which proposals were viewed in the last 7 days but are not accepted yet?"; "Create a draft page from our 'Standard retainer' saved blocks and tag it 'q4-2026'."; "Publish the draft page 'Acme onboarding' and set its link to expire after 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Qwilr data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run qwilr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run qwilr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run qwilr_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. qwilr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: qwilr_list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.description: List Qwilr pages (proposals, quotes, documents) the token can see, newest first, one page of results at a time. Returns summaries only (no content). Use nextCursor as cursor to get the next set. Archived pages need tags=archived. Qwilr API: GET /pages.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the last response. Omit for the first set.

status.description: Only pages with one of these statuses.

tags.description: Only pages that have all of these tags (case-sensitive).

folderId.description: Only pages directly in this folder.

ownerId.description: Only pages owned by this user id.

sort_direction.description: Sort by creation time (default desc, newest first).

expand.description: Extra fields to include in each summary.

tools.name: qwilr_get_page
tools.title: Get a page
tools.description: Get one Qwilr page with all its fields: status, tags, folder, links, expiry and payment settings. Add expand=acceptance to read who accepted it. Qwilr API: GET /pages/{pageId}.

expand.description: Extra fields to include in the page.

tools.name: qwilr_list_saved_blocks
tools.title: List saved blocks
tools.description: List the saved blocks in the account. Their ids go into qwilr_create_page as blocks to build a page from. Qwilr API: GET /blocks/saved.

tools.name: qwilr_list_taxes
tools.title: List taxes
tools.description: List the taxes defined in the account (id, name, rate). Qwilr API: GET /taxes.

tools.name: qwilr_list_payment_gateways
tools.title: List payment gateways
tools.description: List the payment gateways that pages can take payments through. Their ids are used as gatewayId in payment settings. Qwilr API: GET /payment-gateways.

tools.name: qwilr_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users in the account with their roles and teams. Use their ids as ownerId when you create or filter pages. Qwilr API: GET /users.

tools.name: qwilr_create_page
tools.title: Create a page
tools.description: Create a Qwilr page from saved blocks (blocks) OR from a template (template_id); give exactly one. The page is a draft unless published is true: a published page's link works for anyone who has it. Qwilr API: POST /pages.

name.description: Page title, shown as the browser page title.

blocks.description: Saved blocks to build the page from, in order (ids from qwilr_list_saved_blocks).

template_id.description: Template id to build the page from instead of blocks.

published.description: Make the page public now (default false = draft).

owner_id.description: User id who owns the page (default: the token's user).

enabled.description: Turn link expiry on or off.

expireAfterDays.description: Days after publishing until the link stops working (1-365). Required when enabled is true.

expiry.description: Link expiry settings. The page status becomes declined when the link expires.

metadata.description: Your own key/value data; it is returned with all webhooks. Max 500 keys.

substitutions.description: Variable substitutions for the page, keyed by variable reference key (see Qwilr API docs).

tools.name: qwilr_update_page
tools.title: Update a page
tools.description: Change one page: publish or unpublish it (published), set link expiry, move it to a folder (folder_id), or add tags (add_tags; existing tags stay). This tool does not replace page content. Publishing makes the page's link public. Qwilr API: PUT /pages/{pageId}.

published.description: true publishes the page; false returns it to draft.

enabled.description: Turn link expiry on or off.

expireAfterDays.description: Days after publishing until the link stops working (1-365). Required when enabled is true.

expiry.description: Link expiry settings. The page status becomes declined when the link expires.

folder_id.description: Folder id to move the page to.

add_tags.description: Tags to add. Reserved: archived, starred, templateqwilr.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Qwilr
prompts.description: What you can do with Qwilr here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_pages_by_status_and_owner
prompts.title: Find pages by status and owner
prompts.description: List pages newest first, filtered by status, tag or owner. Open one page to read its links and expiry, and who accepted it.

prompts.name: read_the_taxes_and_payment_gateways
prompts.title: Read the taxes and payment gateways
prompts.description: List the taxes defined in the account with their rates. List the payment gateways that pages can take payments through.

prompts.name: create_a_draft_page_from_saved_blocks
prompts.title: Create a draft page from saved blocks
prompts.description: List the saved blocks, then create a page from them. The page stays a draft unless you set it to publish.

prompts.name: publish_a_page_and_set_its_link_expiry
prompts.title: Publish a page and set its link expiry
prompts.description: Publish or unpublish a page, and set when its link expires. A published page's link works for anyone who has it.

prompts.name: see_who_owns_each_page
prompts.title: See who owns each page
prompts.description: List the users with their roles and teams. Use an owner id to filter the pages that person owns.
